decision_scales.comparison: For complete admitted rules, flag absolute mean or variance change at or above its scale. Report signed changes and latent/predictive values even below threshold.
decision_scales.meaning: Noise-referenced prioritization scales fixed before evaluation. They are not numerical tolerances, physical error bounds or coverage tests. Small one-step differences can accumulate in sequential likelihoods; these snapshots cannot quantify that effect.

limits: This degree-three spherical-radial rule approximates moments of the retained local Gaussian. Admitted nodes do not prove Gaussian support, exact nonlinear moments, calibrated coverage or historical adequacy. Node failure fractions are not Gaussian probability estimates.
